The report cites SELECT as the landmark dedicated cardiovascular outcomes trial for GLP-1 RAs beyond diabetes [[1a34ef_p0]].
SELECT evaluated semaglutide and cardiovascular outcomes in obesity without diabetes [[9f327f_p1]].
The trial is summarized as semaglutide 2.4 mg cutting cardiovascular events by 20% [[1a34ef_p0]].
Wegovy received FDA approval for cardiovascular risk reduction in adults with known heart disease and overweight [[69071b_p1]].
The FDA described that approval as the first treatment to reduce risk of serious heart problems specifically in adults with obesity or overweight [[28e567_p1]].
The report also cites FLOW as the dedicated kidney outcomes trial with cardiovascular components in patients with type 2 diabetes and chronic kidney disease [[106f29_p1]].
FLOW showed semaglutide reduced risk for major kidney disease events by 24% [[6aff42_p0]].
That benefit supported FDA approval of Ozempic (semaglutide) as the only GLP-1 RA to reduce the risk of worsening kidney disease and cardiovascular death [[6cec99_p1]].
A FLOW sub-analysis examined cardiovascular outcomes with semaglutide by severity of chronic kidney disease in type 2 diabetes [[713b0c_p2]].
A related summary characterizes FLOW as showing kidney and survival benefits in diabetes with chronic kidney disease [[9c73c0_p1]].
The source corpus also contains publications on cardiovascular outcomes with oral semaglutide in high-risk patients with type 2 diabetes [[9c451b_p0]].

The model returned no answer text for that follow-up, so there was nothing to check against the report's sources.

The report, its sources and its exports are unchanged, and no answer was saved.
